name: Conduit of Worlds
oracle_text:
You may play lands from your graveyard.
{T}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Choose target nonland permanent card in your graveyard. If you haven't cast a spell this turn, you may cast that card. If you do, you can't cast additional spells this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: a one-shot effect that, once the player has cast the chosen card, forbids that player from casting any further spells for the rest of the turn (a timed, player-wide cant_cast_spells with duration this_turn, applied only if the optional cast happened)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cant_cast_spells exists only as a static that lasts while its permanent does, not as an op with a duration; cant_cast_spells_from_zones is an op but restricts zones, not all spells; the packet notes say 'more than one spell each turn' is still a gap

needs.what: an effect that lets the controller cast a targeted card from their graveyard during resolution of an ability, paying its mana cost, with a binding reporting whether it was cast so a following clause can depend on 'if you do'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_hand takes zones but has no documented 'if you do' result binding; grant_playable/grant_graveyard_cast grant a lasting permission rather than a cast during resolution, so the lockout could not be tied to the cast
